results.title: Alcohol consumption increased the risk of prostate cancer: A Finnish pooled population-based cohort study.
results.reason: Full text was indicated but no PMCID was available, so missing evidence could not be recovered.

extraction.population: male participants in six Finnish population-based cohort studies

sample_size.excerpt: We used data from six Finnish population-based cohort studies with data collected between 1972 and 2015 that included a total of 82,570 male participants.

effect_size.excerpt: The hazard ratio (HR) of PCa incidence was 1.18 (95% CI 1.02 - 1.36) for light alcohol consumers, 1.20 (95% CI 1.03 - 1.40) for moderate consumers, and 1.32 (95% CI 1.08 - 1.60) for heavy consumers.

confidence_interval.excerpt: The hazard ratio (HR) of PCa incidence was 1.18 (95% CI 1.02 - 1.36) for light alcohol consumers, 1.20 (95% CI 1.03 - 1.40) for moderate consumers, and 1.32 (95% CI 1.08 - 1.60) for heavy consumers.

comparison.excerpt: Alcohol consumption, among light, moderate, and heavy consumers, was associated with an increased incidence of PCa when compared to non-drinkers.

design.excerpt: We used data from six Finnish population-based cohort studies with data collected between 1972 and 2015 that included a total of 82,570 male participants.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Information on participants' alcohol consumption, BMI, height, smoking status, education, and physical activity were harmonized and categorized.
